papers.title: Performance of Maraging Steel Sleeves Produced by SLM with Subsequent Age Hardening
papers.abstract: In the paper, the researches on sleeves made out of maraging steel 1.2709 using selective laser melting (SLM) technology are presented. This additive technology is recognized as favorable for the environment, due to 100% use of material and durability of manufactured details. The fabricated sleeves underwent subsequent tests, in particular, microhardness, porosity and homogeneity of the material was examined before and after heat treatment and salt bath nitrocarburizing process. Two kinds of fatigue tests were performed. The first consisted of the typical sinusoidal alternating load, the other was the high pressure pulse load test close to the real work conditions. It is of high importance that the fatigue strength of the tested sleeves is considerably higher than that of the similarly produced details shaped as a standard samples for tensile stress. The Mössbauer spectrometry analysis of hyperfine magnetic field distributions proved that SLM did not change considerably the martensite structure at atomic level.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是工业用马氏体时效钢套筒，而非生物医用植入体，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical material (e.g., Ti6Al4V), no porous structure or stiffness matching, no osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估选区激光熔化制造的马氏体时效钢套筒性能。
summary_zh.method: 进行硬度、孔隙率、疲劳测试及穆斯堡尔谱分析。
summary_zh.result: 套筒疲劳强度高于标准拉伸试样。
summary_zh.validation: 机械测试和光谱分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the performance of maraging steel sleeves fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Microhardness, porosity, fatigue tests, and Mössbauer spectrometry were conducted.
summary_en.result: Fatigue strength of the sleeves was higher than that of standard tensile samples.
